raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Shon is trying to rally Ziv against me by highlighting my lead and framing me as the immediate threat to justify his own coordination. He's trying to get a trade for טיט to advance himself while keeping me blocked. Fortunately, Ziv claims to have no טיט, which stalls their progress. I need a 6 or 10 for טיט or an 8 for כבשה/חיטה to secure my final settlement at node 23. I should downplay my position to reduce the heat.","note_to_self":"Shon is actively pushing the 'Hadar is about to win' narrative to isolate me. I need 1 טיט and 1 כבשה to win at node 23.","say_outloud":"שון, אתה ממש מנסה להפוך אותי למטרה, אה? בסך הכל קיבלתי עץ אחד מה-11 הזה, בדיוק כמוך. וזיו, אל תדאג, ה'נס' שלי לא יקרה בקרוב אם הטיט פשוט נעלם מהמפה."}

parsed.internal_thinking: Shon is trying to rally Ziv against me by highlighting my lead and framing me as the immediate threat to justify his own coordination. He's trying to get a trade for טיט to advance himself while keeping me blocked. Fortunately, Ziv claims to have no טיט, which stalls their progress. I need a 6 or 10 for טיט or an 8 for כבשה/חיטה to secure my final settlement at node 23. I should downplay my position to reduce the heat.
parsed.note_to_self: Shon is actively pushing the 'Hadar is about to win' narrative to isolate me. Ziv is currently resource-poor and hasn't bitten on Shon's trade yet. I need 1 טיט and 1 כבשה to win at node 23.
parsed.say_outloud: שון, אתה ממש מנסה להפוך אותי למטרה, אה? בסך הכל קיבלתי עץ אחד מה-11 הזה, בדיוק כמוך. וזיו, אל תדאג, ה'נס' שלי לא יקרה בקרוב אם הטיט פשוט נעלם מהמפה.
